windows-media-player-for-palm-size-pc: Microsoft's Windows Media Player for the Palm-size PC, with notes on system requirements, CF card use and licensed file transfer.
windows-media-player-7.1-for-pocket-pc-3: Microsoft's Windows Media Player 7.1 for Pocket PC, combining local and streaming playback with support for Windows Media Audio/Video 8 and full-screen landscape.
windows-media-player-for-pocket-pc-8.0: An updated version of the Windows Media Player built into Pocket PC 2002, offering minor improvements and fixes; the original player must already be present.
tucows_76856_Primer: A reader that lets Windows CE users view PDF files on an H/PC or P/PC.
windows-mobile-sdks-2023: A collection of Microsoft SDKs across the generations from Palm-size PC 1.x to Windows Mobile 6, including the Pocket PC 2000, 2002 and Smartphone development kits.
windows-phone-desktop-app: Microsoft's official PC application for syncing Windows Phone 8 and later phones with Windows 7 and later computers.
windows-mobile-device-center: The Windows Mobile Device Center installer, with notes describing how to adjust service settings to get it working on Windows 10.
windows-phone-pdalife: A collection of Windows Phone 7.x and 8.x games and programs originally hosted on PDALife, preserved as .xap and .rar files to keep this chapter of mobile software history.
windows-sideshow-gadgets-emulator-window: Includes nine rare Windows SideShow gadgets, the SideShow device emulator and the Windows Mobile version of the SideShow application.
windows10sdkmsewindows10mobile: The Windows 10 SDK with the Windows 10 Mobile emulator, for developers building, testing and deploying UWP apps targeting Windows 10 Mobile.
windows_mobile_apps: A collection of Windows Mobile application CAB installers, such as SploitDemo, with little accompanying documentation.
windows-phone-mac: The Mac version of the Windows Phone sync app for transferring content to a Windows Phone, possibly only for the WP8 series.
windowsmediaplayerforpocketpc-technology: Windows Media Player for Pocket PC Technology Preview 2, which plays .wma, .asf and .wmv files and streams wirelessly with Windows Media Services.
windowsmobile: A collection of Windows Mobile apps and tools gathered from forums and FTP sites, mostly out-of-print software, with a description text file for every file.
windowsmobileapps: A hard-won collection of Windows Mobile programs that run on Windows Mobile 2003 or 6.1.
wm-6.1-v.-1.6-amadeus: Custom Windows Mobile 6.1/6.5 Standard firmware for the HTC Typhoon, Feeler and Amadeus, with English and Russian, .NET CF 3.5 and T9 input.
windows-pocket-pc-2000: A collection of Pocket PC 2000 and 2002 games and programs, including PocketDOS, MorphGear, nesterJ and many more.
winmobile-2003-se-v-3: x86 virtual disk images of Pocket PC 2002, Smartphone 2002 and Windows Mobile 2003/2003 SE that run in QEMU, VirtualBox and VMware.
wmcave: A faithful Pocket PC version of the classic cave-flying game SFCave, simple to play and endlessly replayable.
wm6.x-build-collection: A collection of Windows Mobile 6.x system builds, including device-specific ROMs and general system dumps, with more being added over time.
wm2005v2: The WM 2005v2 firmware image for the Motorola MPx200 smartphone, for flashing and preservation.
wm_uc_port: A port of the Qualcomm Windows Mobile version of Need for Speed: Undercover to Android and Windows PCs, with an optimized build included.
wmdc-win-10-11: The complete Windows Mobile Device Center installer, with patches that make it work on Windows 10/11.
wmemu: A portable version of Microsoft's Device Emulator that emulates Windows CE and Windows Mobile on a PC, with a Windows Mobile 2003 SE ROM included.
wpbackup: A PC tool for backing up Windows Phone 7 data before flashing a ROM, saving contacts, text messages, documents, Wi-Fi passwords, alarms and more.
wmdc-pack: The Windows Mobile Device Center installer, with fixes for using it on Windows 10.
x-1-hard-spl-v-1: An archive of HardSPL unlocking files for the Sony Ericsson Xperia X1, originally sourced from an XDA thread.
wpdb_archive: An archive of Windows Phone ROMs from non-Nokia brands gathered from various sources, in case the original files disappear.
wmdc_for_Win10_and_oward: Windows Mobile Device Center for newer versions of Windows, with two extra files that help it run properly on Windows 10 and later.
wmx5dell: Dell's official upgrade disc, which runs a setup program from the PC to upgrade the Axim X5 to Pocket PC 2003 Premium Edition.
x-51v-roms: A collection of ROMs for the Dell Axim X51v, including the stock WM5 and several community-made custom WM6.1 and WM6.5 ROMs.
windowsce1.0: A collection of programs made for the earliest Windows CE 1.0, PocketDOS among them.
zio-simcity-2000: ZIO Interactive's SimCity 2000 for Pocket PC in two versions, one of which fixes the budget screen scrollbar not appearing on newer Windows Mobile releases.
everquest: A single-player handheld edition of the classic online role-playing game EverQuest: create a character, explore the lands of Norrath and save anytime. This is the game this project originally set out to bring back to life.
